newsitem.title: INDIA: India RBI faces task managing rising reserves-CMIE.
newsitem.headline: India RBI faces task managing rising reserves-CMIE.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India faces a tough task managing the monetisation of burgeoning foreign currency reserve growth, the Centre for Monitoring Indian Economy monthly report said.

The CMIE's May report noted the RBI had mopped up $2.0 billion in March and a further $1.45 billion in April and the first three weeks of May. The RBI has been intervening aggressively in the currency market to stop the rupee from appreciating, by selling rupees for dollars.
It said the RBI has effectively managed increased rupee liquidity by sterilising increase in domestic money supply through open market operations and securities repurchase transactions.
It said while the RBI foreign assets rose from nine percent in July to 27 percent in April, reserve money growth has been growing at single digit growth.
